recipe.name: Slow Cooker Beef Stroganoff
ingredients: 2 pounds beef stew meat (or chuck roast, cut into 1-inch cubes)
1 tablespoon Dijon mustard (optional, for depth of flavor)
instructions: Prepare the slow cooker base: Place beef, onion, garlic, and mushrooms into the slow cooker.
Add seasonings: Pour in beef broth, Worcestershire sauce, Dijon mustard, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Cook: Cover and cook on low for 6–7 hours or on high for 4 hours, until beef is tender.
Thicken the sauce: In a small bowl, mix cornstarch and water until smooth. Stir this slurry into the slow cooker during the last 30 minutes of cooking to thicken the sauce.
Finish with sour cream: Just before serving, stir in sour cream until fully combined and creamy.
Serve: Spoon beef and sauce over cooked egg noodles. Garnish with parsley.
